about: Every package motion-connectors installs, as a consumer outside the repository reaches it. scripts/check_installed_consumer.py checks the prefix for each, and CMakeLists.txt beside this file find_package()s each at the repository's major.minor and links its target. A new library adds its row in the change that creates it, with the source profile it installs, if any. A configure with a connector switched off passes the packages it built (--package), and the lane checks and consumes those rows only. The first package to find motionCore also puts the installed usd-motion-plugins prefix on the consumer's CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH; the transport and the wire format find nothing.
